vibe_rationale: Real outdoor and camp culture, but a magazine-run, brand-heavy format with vendor booths that leans commercial and is thin on subculture.
fit_notes: Adult outdoor and camping readers (families and dog owners included) with a clear outdoor-living angle, and the publisher openly sells sampling plans to brands. Sleep, warmth and recovery products fit. Attendance is a publisher projection with conflicting dates, so treat the figure with caution. Japan-based.
